Psychoactive Pharmaceuticals
Psychoactive Pharmaceuticals are over-the-counter or prescription drugs approved for human medicinal use. The inclusion of chemicals in this list is not intended to suggest that they are necessarily used recreationally. The substances described have mind- or emotion-altering properties or may be listed because they have possible interactions with recreationally used chemicals.
Nearly 70 percent of Americans take at least one prescription drug and one in five takes at least three. (Health, United States 2014 by the US CDC)
